h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Srinagar

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Srinagar

c: In Srinagar the outdoor season and the frozen season are very different, and an outdoor gym has to be planned for both. Summer and autumn bring long, pleasant days by the Dal Lake and in the city's gardens. The coldest weeks of winter bring snow and sub-zero nights. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Srinagar for schools, colleges, government campuses, parks and hotels, from our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,650 km away.

Every machine in our Fun Fitness range is galvanised pipe with moulded seats and handles, built in-house and inspected before dispatch. That construction does not crack or rust when snow sits on it and melts. We send the order by road, and installation is by our team or a dealer in north India once you approve the layout.

richText.heading: Getting an outdoor gym through a Kashmir winter

c: Before the first snowfall, have staff tighten all bolts and check that bearings turn smoothly. During the cold months, clear snow from footplates and seats, and close the gym if surfaces are iced, since they become slippery. When spring comes, wipe down every machine and recheck the moving parts.

items.q: Can outdoor gym equipment stay outside through a Srinagar winter?
items.a: Yes. The galvanised frames and moulded parts are not damaged by snow or frost. Clear snow from the machines and avoid using them when they are iced over.

items.q: When is the best time to install in Kashmir?
items.a: Installation is easiest in spring, summer or early autumn, when the ground is not frozen and concrete for the base can set properly. Plan the order accordingly.

items.q: Do you supply hotels and houseboat operators?
items.a: We supply hotels and resorts across India. A small set of machines in a garden or on a lawn suits guests who want to exercise outdoors in the summer season.
